sourceDesc.p: Comments and notes to 秦律十八種.

p.seg: 粟 does not refer to millet here but to all kinds of grain in general with regard to its expected yield.
輒 means "immediately" in administrative texts like this.
頃數 forms the core of the nominal phrase that is the object of the verb 言.
早 is a misspelling of 旱.
Both 𧈸 (zhong) and 䖵 (kun) are umbrella terms for flying and crawling creatures that harm the crop.
Following 戰國秦漢簡帛古書通假字彙纂, 450a-b, and 非簡帛類戰國文字通假材料的整理與研究, 175, we read 夜 as a loan for zhì 炙, "to burn".
Following Shuihudi Qin mu zhujian, 2001, transcription, p. 20, n. 4, we understand 生荔 as referring to unripe and shell-covered shoots of plants.
Following Shuihudi Qin mu zhujian, 2001, transcription, p. 20, we understand 綰享 as a loan for 棺槨.
Following Shuihudi Qin mu zhujian, 2001, transcription, p. 21, n. 10, we understand 河 as a loan for 呵.
Since this is a regulation addressed at officials, the lexical aspect of many verbs is tolerative.

The two normalized characters 穌 and 藶 should be inserted into the fourth and sixth position: 芻自黃穌及藶束以上皆受之。See Shuihuidi Qin mu zhujian 2001, transcriptions, p. 21, n. 3. For the corresponding inscriptional characters and their transcriptions see https://zi.tools/zi/𳑊 and https://zi.tools/zi/藶.
Read 勿 as a loan for wú 無, "not have".
